'''The Block''', also known as '''The Blockhouse''', was the oldest standing structure on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]]. It was originally the fortress for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] troops but after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was secured, it was turned into a [[Prison/Legends|detainment facility]].<ref name="Game" />

It was two stories tall, with a long and low profile. It had one entrance, protected by triple [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]]. The [[Freeport Security Force]] had significantly upgraded the building. The walls were blast-proof, and all ventilation and sewage pipes were less than a half-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] wide to prevent infiltration.<ref name="Game" />

The facility was run by the Freeport Security Force, and the administrative offices were located right inside the door of The Block.<ref name="Game" />
